Content: This record summarizes a historical council review, not an active roadmap. The review established a current governance rule for MemorySmith memory design: use convention-first, validation-backed, evidence-gated changes before promoting new durable schema fields. The related page sources hold the RFC and council workflow details. Existing implemented conventions include tag namespaces, diagnostics, staleness warnings, relationship/source-link checks, chat trace evidence, and warning-first maintenance. Proposed schema fields such as Relations, Constraints, ValidUntil, ReviewAfter, or Priority remain page-level design material until code and retrieval behavior need reliable machine parsing. The LLM council page is a MemorySmith-specific multi-perspective review workflow.
Title: Memory System RFC Council Review
